subject: relay routing facts for shell jobs
body: From the relay side, routing is tool-driven: whichever tool is called is the intent and target. For Mac work, the relay can call mac_run_actions (direct action list) or mac_delegate (goal for the Mac planner). There’s no separate intent enum or context object; spoken_reply is the owner-facing output. Jobs are observed via the bridge endpoints the Mac polls; queued work appears when the relay posts to /v1/bridge/work (via the harness). The relay is the low-latency front door and should hand off non-interactive work to the Mac tier to save cost.
